verdict.rationale: Core workflows are documented as available through the API. Customer screening can run synchronously, asynchronously or in batches, and cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated via either the web app or the API. A downloadable OpenAPI schema and Postman collection back this up. However, there is no documented commitment to full UI/API parity, and API credentials and their permissions are managed in the web application. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage of risk-score equation configuration, API coverage of screening-configuration management and access/credential management, and independent hands-on corroboration.
